userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for transcription focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-74-002 through US-74-012) covering: video metadata extraction, context-enriched matching, chapter detection, listicle detection, cross-chapter grouping, iterative match context, context enrichment config, metadata cache integration, title-enriched embeddings, tag keyword boost, and description chapter parsing.

userStories.title: Extract video metadata (description, chapters, tags) during caption fetch
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionFetcher.fetch_captions() populates video_description, video_chapters, and video_tags on CaptionResult when info_dict is available
Description is truncated to configurable max length (default 500 chars) before storing
Chapters are extracted as list of dicts with title, start_time, end_time keys
Tags are extracted as list of strings from info_dict['tags']
When info_dict fields are missing or None, fields default to empty string/list without errors
Unit tests verify extraction from mock info_dict with all fields present, partially present, and fully absent
userStories.notes: HARD STORY: Skipped after 3_failures - pending decomposition

userStories.title: Add title-relevance scoring adjustment to match confidence
acceptanceCriteria: New scoring adjustment 'title_relevance' added to apply_all_adjustments() in scoring.py
Extracts keywords from voiceover segment text and video title, computes overlap
Graduated boost applied: 1 keyword match gives +0.03, 2+ matches gives +0.05, 3+ matches gives +0.08
Adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown dict under key 'title_relevance'
When video title is empty or unavailable, adjustment is 0.0 (no error)
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented in US-70-006. All 5 criteria verified: title_relevance in apply_all_adjustments (line 2903), keyword extraction+overlap (2291-2298), graduated boosts 0.03/0.05/0.08 (2214-2216), breakdown key title_relevance (2911), empty title returns 0.0 (2288-2289). Fixed mock_config missing language_confidence_penalty causing test failure. 10/10 tests pass.

userStories.title: Inject video context into LLM reranker prompts
acceptanceCriteria: LLM reranker prompt includes 'Video context: {title}. {first_sentence_of_description}' for each candidate
Description is truncated to first sentence or 100 chars, whichever is shorter
When description is empty, only title is included without trailing period
When both title and description are empty, no context line is added
Unit test verifies prompt construction with various title/description combinations
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented in US-70-007. All 5 criteria verified: (1) _build_video_context formats 'Video context: {title}. {first_sentence}' (line 204), (2) description split on '.' then capped at 100 chars (lines 198-200), (3) empty description yields title only without trailing period ('. '.join on single-element list), (4) both empty returns '' and no context added (lines 190-191, 227), (5) 36 tests in test_matching_llm_reranker.py cover all combinations including test_build_video_context_* and test_enrich_candidates_*. All 36 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add chapter-segment mapping for video chapters
acceptanceCriteria: New function maps each CaptionSegment to its containing VideoChapter by timestamp overlap
Segments spanning chapter boundaries are assigned to the chapter with the most temporal overlap
Mapping result stored as chapter_index and chapter_title on TranscriptSegment in state.py
When no chapters are available, all segments get chapter_index=None
Unit tests cover: single chapter, multi-chapter, boundary spanning, no chapters
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented in US-73-002/US-70-009. All 5 criteria verified: (1) map_segments_to_chapters in src/chapter_detector/mapping.py maps by temporal overlap, (2) best_overlap tracking picks chapter with most overlap for boundary-spanning segments, (3) TranscriptSegment has chapter_index/chapter_title fields (state.py:60-61), stored via caption_stage.py:1828-1829, (4) empty chapters returns -1 (mapping.py:30), (5) 11 mapping tests + 11 topic scoring tests all pass. Fixed mock config missing language_confidence_penalty.

userStories.title: Add chapter-topic-match scoring adjustment
acceptanceCriteria: New scoring adjustment 'chapter_topic_match' in apply_all_adjustments()
When both voiceover and video have chapter structure, computes topic keyword similarity
Topic match gives graduated boost +0.05 to +0.10 based on keyword overlap ratio
Topic mismatch (overlap=0 when both have chapters) gives penalty -0.05
Adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown under key 'chapter_topic_match'
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented in US-72-007 (commit 705cd74). apply_chapter_topic_match() in scoring.py:2361 with constants CHAPTER_TOPIC_BOOST_PARTIAL=0.05, CHAPTER_TOPIC_BOOST_STRONG=0.10, CHAPTER_TOPIC_MISMATCH_PENALTY=-0.05. Wired into apply_all_adjustments() step 7. All 8 tests pass in TestChapterTopicMatch.

userStories.title: Implement voiceover listicle detection
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py with detect_listicle_structure() function
Detects ordinal markers (first, second, third, finally, lastly) at segment boundaries
Detects numbered markers (#1, number one, step 1, item 1) at segment starts
Detects transition markers (next up, moving on to, let's talk about) at segment starts
Returns list of ListicleGroup dataclass objects with group_id, item_label, start_segment_idx, end_segment_idx
Unit tests cover: ordinals, numbers, transitions, mixed styles, no listicle structure
userStories.notes: Tier: Feature (Area 4). New file: src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py. ListicleGroup dataclass can go in src/chapter_detection/models.py or in the new module. Integration with existing src/chapter_detection/detector.py (EnhancedChapterDetector) as an additional detection pass - if YouTube chapters exist use those, fall back to listicle detection otherwise. Tests: tests/test_listicle*.py

userStories.title: Add context enrichment config section
acceptanceCriteria: New ContextEnrichmentConfig dataclass in src/config/sections/matching.py with fields: extract_video_description (bool), extract_video_chapters (bool), extract_video_tags (bool), max_description_length (int), title_enriched_embeddings (bool)
MatchingConfig includes context_enrichment field with __post_init__ conversion from dict
config.yaml updated with matching.context_enrichment section and defaults
Config accessible via config.matching_config.context_enrichment with getattr fallback
Unit test verifies config loads from YAML and handles missing section gracefully
userStories.notes: Tier: Foundation config. Files: src/config/sections/matching.py (add ContextEnrichmentConfig dataclass), config.yaml (add matching.context_enrichment section). Follow existing pattern from other config sections - use __post_init__ for nested dataclass conversion per Rule 2. Tests: tests/test_config*.py, tests/test_cli_config_utils.py

userStories.title: Integrate metadata into transcription cache
acceptanceCriteria: TranscriptCache stores video_description, video_chapters, and video_tags alongside transcription segments
Cache lookup returns metadata fields when available (backward compatible - missing fields default to empty)
Cache hit preserves metadata from original transcription without re-fetching
Existing cached transcriptions without metadata load successfully with empty defaults
Unit tests verify: save with metadata, load with metadata, load legacy cache without metadata
userStories.notes: Tier: Enhancement. File: src/transcription/cache.py (TranscriptCache class ~line 1). Currently cache only stores source_file and segments, not metadata. Add metadata fields to the cache serialization format. Must be backward compatible with existing cache files. Tests: tests/test_transcription*.py, tests/test_cache*.py

userStories.title: Add tag-based keyword boost to scoring
acceptanceCriteria: When video_tags are available on a candidate, they are fed into the existing keyword_boost mechanism
Tag keywords that overlap with voiceover segment keywords trigger the existing keyword boost
No new scoring code needed - tags are injected into the keyword matching system upstream
When video_tags is empty, behavior is unchanged from current
Unit test verifies tag-keyword overlap triggers boost
userStories.notes: Tier: Enhancement (Area 2). File: src/matching/scoring.py - look at existing keyword_boost mechanism (~line 2423+) and ensure video_tags are included in the keyword pool. Tags come from VideoSearchResult.video_tags or CaptionResult.video_tags. Tests: tests/test_scoring*.py

userStories.title: Parse chapters from video description text
acceptanceCriteria: When info_dict['chapters'] is empty/missing, parse timestamp-title pairs from description text
Regex handles common YouTube formats: '0:00 Intro', '00:00 - Title', '1:23:45 Section Name'
Parsed chapters have correct start_time (seconds), end_time (inferred from next chapter or video end), and title
When description has no timestamp patterns, returns empty list without errors
Unit tests cover: standard format, dash separator, HH:MM:SS format, no timestamps, malformed timestamps
userStories.notes: Tier: Enhancement (Area 1). File: src/caption_fetcher.py - add parse_chapters_from_description() function near enrich_with_metadata() (~line 2266). Called as fallback when info_dict['chapters'] is empty. Regex pattern: r'(?:^|\n)\s*(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2}){1,2})\s*[-\s]\s*(.+)' for common YouTube description chapter formats. Tests: tests/test_caption_fetcher*.py

userStories.title: Add source consistency boost within voiceover chapters
acceptanceCriteria: New scoring adjustment 'chapter_source_consistency' in apply_all_adjustments()
Within a single voiceover chapter, candidates from the same video source as previous segment get +0.03 boost
Boost only applies when voiceover has detected chapter/listicle structure
consecutive_source_penalty is suppressed within chapter boundaries (coherence > diversity)
Adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown under key 'chapter_source_consistency'
userStories.notes: Tier: Polish (Area 3). Depends on US-74-005 and US-74-006. File: src/matching/scoring.py - add new adjustment. Requires knowing the previous segment's matched source within the same voiceover chapter. May need to pass chapter context into the scoring function. Tests: tests/test_scoring*.py, tests/test_match*.py
